source.geographicScope: Nigeria; source workbook contains zonal records for Derived savannah, Humid forest, Northern guinean savannah, and Southern guinean savannah, plus one Borno-state Sahelian savannah record that is not assigned to an LGA zone.
source.notes: The source states that the workbook covers sowing and harvesting dates and sowing/planting rates by agro-ecological zone; the imported entries use only explicit sowing date ranges. It reports FAO lineage and a 2014 data collection date. Harvest dates are not supplied in the imported rows. Cassava planting-rate cells were excluded because their displayed values are malformed or unclear. The source's preferred sowing/planting period fields are blank. The month windows are draft source transcriptions, not verified field advice.

windows.reviewNotes: Broad zone-level source range. The source does not provide LGA-specific dates, varieties, harvest dates, or field conditions. Keep this entry in draft status until an agronomist confirms local applicability.
